title: Local Expected Utility in Infinite-Dimensional Spaces: Theory and Elicitation
abstract: arXiv:2609.25026v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops a decision-theoretic interpretation of local expected utility on Abstract Wiener space. The framework is intended for economic acts that are naturally stochastic paths, such as income paths, consumption paths, investment payoffs, insurance losses, or laboratory stimuli unfolding over a continuum of contingencies. In this setting the object of choice is an act or payoff path, while Hermite functions serve as state-feature coordinates rather than objects of preference. Abstract Wiener space supplies a Gaussian reference measure on the Banach space of paths and a Hilbert subspace on which local utility is represented by orthogonal coefficients. The associated Wiener-integral weights are generally signed stochastic functionals; they become admissible decision weights only after a specified nonnegative normalization. translated_title: 无穷维空间中的局部期望效用：理论与引出
translated_abstract: 本文在抽象维纳空间上发展了局部期望效用的决策论解释。该框架适用于那些天然表现为随机路径的经济行为，例如收入路径、消费路径、投资收益、保险损失，或在连续或有状态上展开的实验室刺激。在这一设定中，选择的对象是一个行为或收益路径，而厄米函数则充当状态特征坐标，而非偏好对象。抽象维纳空间为路径的巴拿赫空间提供了高斯参考测度，以及一个希尔伯特子空间，在该子空间上局部效用由正交系数表示。相关的维纳积分权重通常是有符号的随机泛函；只有在经过特定的非负规范化之后，它们才能成为可接受的决策权重。这一区分澄清了该模型与状态依赖效用、主观期望效用之间的关系。
tldr: 该论文将局部期望效用理论推广至无穷维抽象维纳空间，用以刻画收入、消费等随机路径型经济行为，并明确了维纳积分权重经非负规范化后才可成为合法决策权重，从而厘清了该模型与状态依赖效用及主观期望效用的关系。
en_tdlr: This paper extends local expected utility theory to infinite-dimensional Abstract Wiener spaces to model stochastic path-based economic acts, and clarifies that Wiener-integral weights become admissible decision weights only after nonnegative normalization, distinguishing the model from state-dependent utility and subjective expected utility.
